name: Model Kit Studio
description:
About This Game

Your brother Alex, a renowned model builder, is on a work trip, and you’re looking after his plants. His place, however, happens to be a model builder’s paradise, and you’ve been left with all the tools to assemble, customise, and photograph your very own mecha model collection!

Ding dong, a delivery person hands you a package... A model robot with a note signed A.

What are you waiting for? Grab those sprues and get cutting!

  • Realistic Model Making - Cut, file, and assemble your mecha step by step.

  • Deep Customisation - Paint by hand with brushes or an airbrush. Add decals for extra detail. 

  • Photo Studio - Immortalise your mechas. Pose, create dioramas, and share your creations.

  • Immersive Environment - Freely explore the loft studio and uncover a story.

  • Original Models - Enjoy original mecha models explicitly designed for Model Kit Studio.

Follow the interactive instructions as you cut, file, assemble, and customise your mecha piece by piece. MKS offers a simple, realistic, intuitive, and richly crafted experience.

Open the manual and slip into a flow state as you craft and vibe to the music. Before you know it, your collection has grown even bigger.

Explore the environment and uncover a story that stems from the passion for model-building. Meet four intriguing characters – Ysé, Noémie, Dante and Kenji – who will immerse you in a world of enthusiasts.

Paint, pose, and photograph your models, then share them with the community. Be inspired by how others have customised their models.

We think you'll love Model Kit Studio if you enjoy...

Model Builder, Mech Builder, Last Call BBS, Unpacking, Warhammer, House Flipper 2, Hozy, House Builder, MakeRoom, Tiny Glade, PC Building Simulator
short_desc: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.
